description: This is a Java interface named BankingService defining service methods related to banking operations such as customer management, account management, and transaction retrieval.

classes.name: BankingService
classes.description: A Java interface for banking operations/services including customer and account management and transaction retrieval.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Adds a new customer with provided customer details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds customer details by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates customer information identified by customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer based on customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds account details using account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account linked to a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs transfer operation with transfer details for a specific customer.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a specific account number.
